Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-groups"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web client plugin: a complete workspace grouping manager.**

> drag-and-drop grouping, free ordering of projects and groups, r"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ule-based
> auto-classification, and tree-shaped search. Every action takes effect
> **immediately a"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"nd persists**, with **zero intrusion** on official data."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Grouped tree browsing
- **Group folder → project folder → session row**, both levels collapsible"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"; expansion state
persists independently (`dsh.workspace.groups.view.v1`, survives refresh/restart)
"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"- **Top-level project rows**: ungrouped projects (matching no rule, dragged out of a group,

same level — **the"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"re is no "未分类" bucket**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Group management (full lifecycle)
- **Create groups manually**: the "新建分组" button in the section"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" header shows the group
immediately (empty groups render too)
- **Rename / delete any group**: every"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" group row (**rule categories included**) has a hover
`⋯` menu; deleting a group sends all of its pr"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ojects back to the **top level**;
rule-category rename/delete rides the overlay (`renamed` / `hidden"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"`),
**the rule YAML stays untouched**
- **Rule-based auto-classification**: the sidecar YAML declare"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"s category rules (`pathPrefix` /
`pathExact` / `nameContains` / `basenameContains`); edit the config"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" to adjust grouping
without touching code"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Drag-and-drop grouping + ordering
- **Drag projects into groups**: drop on any group row or on a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" project row inside a group
(cross-group move = overrides the rule classification)
- **Drag projects"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" OUT of a group**: the **entire top-level area** is the move-out drop

any top-level row (reorder before/after it"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"), on the blank space below the last row

- **Reorder projects inside a group**: top half of a project row = insert before it,

- **Insertion position indicator**: a 2px line (above/below "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"the row) shows the exact drop

- **Level-aware "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"folding, auto-restored**: dragging a project folds every project row

(project rows keep their expansion) — dragend"},{"id":"p9s15","text":" restores the pre-drag expansion snapshot
- **Distinct row icons**: group rows use a folder glyph, p"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"roject rows a project glyph
(same as the official workspace browser) — groups and projects are easy "},{"id":"p9s17","text":" project glyph

- **Tree-shaped search**: results keep the three-level structure (category →"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" project → matched

- Every manual action (groups, grouping, ordering, rename, hide) is"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" written to the plugin's own

- **Zero intr"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"usion**: never touches `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`, session on-disk

- **Self-contained"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" artifact**: `lib/` is prebuilt and shipped with the repo — installing from

- All data comes from the runtime API: the `useW"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"orkspaces` / `useSessions` global hooks and

and `PUT /workspace-groups/manual` accepts the full overlay (manual groups, per"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"-workspace

and writes it atomically to `$DSH_HOME/workspace-groups.manual.json`.
- **Classification priority*"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"*: manual override (written by drag/menu; `null` = forced
top-level, rules ignored) → YAML rule clas"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"sification (hidden rule categories are inert)
→ **top level** (ungrouped projects render as top-leve"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"l rows). The YAML is never
